about: How one Worker's binding to another is typed: each Worker's entrypoint classes and the Durable Object classes other Workers bind, by the Worker's folder, each with its source and the contract interface it implements (contract/src/<module>.ts#<interface>, with args when the interface is generic), and default naming the class a binding with no entrypoint reaches; and each queue's message type (contract/src/<module>.ts#<type>), by its producers' binding, the key QUEUES (contract/src/queue-names.ts) names the queue by, so no queue's name is restated here. npm run generate (ci/kit/types.ts) types every service, Durable Object and queue producer binding from this, and the services guard (contract/guards/services.test.ts) holds each class to its contract.
